description_en: Modifies a Destination Network Address Translation (DNAT) rule
name: ModifyForwardEntry

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNAT entry
parameters.name: forward_entry_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DNAT entry. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: DNAT规则的名称。长度为2~128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: forward_entry_name

parameters.help_en: The probe port. The port must be within the internal port range. By default, this parameter is left empty
parameters.help_zh: DNAT的探测端口，需要在内网端口范围内。默认值为空
parameters.name: health_check_port

parameters.help_en: The EIP in the DNAT entry. The public IP address is used to access the Internet
parameters.help_zh: DNAT条目中提供公网访问的弹性公网IP地址
parameters.name: external_ip

parameters.help_en:
The external port or port range that is used for port forwarding.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

To specify a port range, separate the first port and the last port with a forward slash (/), such as 10/20. The first port and the last port are included.

If you set ExternalPort to a port range, you must also set InternalPort to a port range. The number of ports in the port ranges must be the same. For example, if you set ExternalPort to 10/20, you can set InternalPort to 80/90.

The maximum port range is 1000
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行端口转发的外部端口或端口段。
输入的端口范围需要在1~65535之间。
如果需要在端口段内转发，请在输入时以正斜线（/）隔开起始端口，前后端口都会生效，例如10/20。
如果ExternalPort设置为端口段，则InternalPort也需要设置为端口段，且端口段的端口个数相同，例如ExternalPort设置为10/20，InternalPort设置为80/90。
端口段范围最大为1000
parameters.name: external_port

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the instance that uses the DNAT entry for Internet communication
parameters.help_zh: 通过DNAT条目进行公网通信的实例的私网IP地址
parameters.name: internal_ip

parameters.help_en:
The private port or port range that is used in port forwarding.

Valid values: 1 to 65535.

To specify a port range, separate the first port and the last port with a forward slash (/), such as 10/20. The first port and the last port are included.

If you set InternalPort to a port range, you must also set ExternalPort to a port range. The number of ports in the port ranges must be the same. For example, if you set ExternalPort to 10/20, you can set InternalPort to 80/90.

The maximum port range is 1000
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行端口转发的内部端口或端口段。
输入的端口范围需要在1~65535之间。
如果需要在端口段内转发，请在输入时以正斜线（/）隔开起始端口，前后端口都会生效，例如10/20。
如果设置为端口段，则ExternalPort也需要设置为端口段，且端口段的端口个数相同，例如ExternalPort设置为10/20，InternalPort设置为80/90。
端口段范围最大为1000
parameters.name: internal_port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol. Valid values:

TCP: forwards TCP packets.

UDP: forwards UDP packets.

Any (default): forwards all packets
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型，取值： 

TCP：转发TCP协议的报文。   

UDP：转发UDP协议的报文。   

Any（默认）：转发所有协议的报文
parameters.name: ip_protocol
